jobs.title: Network Fulfilment Data Scientist
jobs.description:
Overview

Imagine
. With over 1,400 stores throughout the U.S. and a thriving supply chain network, there has never been a greater need for people of high initiative, of big-picture thinking, and adaptability to share in our journey. At Ulta Beauty, we have greater ambitions
. Growing what works. Iterating in areas that have promise. Creating new offerings for industry advantage.

In all of this is the opportunity to experience real impact, to effectuate change, to give wings to a spirit of creativity and entrepreneurism. Because the challenges are multi-faceted and ever-changing. But for those inspired by real-world demands that press and stretch, that call for new and smarter ideas, that require heavy doses of trust and respect, Ulta Beauty encourages you to imagine with us.

THE IMPACT YOU CAN HAVE:

As a Network Fulfillment Data Scientist, you will play a pivotal role in delivering possibilities in every direction by harnessing the power of data to optimize fulfillment across our enterprise. You will transform complex data into actionable insights, predictive capabilities, and prescriptive recommendations. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify high-value business opportunities and develop advanced analytical solutions that enable better strategic and operational decision-making. Your insights will drive strategic decisions, enhance operational efficiency, and empower us to exceed guest expectations.

You will do this by utilizing advanced modeling techniques and optimization algorithms to design and evaluate various omnichannel fulfillment scenarios, considering factors such as, but not limited to fulfillment costs, transportation costs, inventory, transit times, and demand patterns with the goal of delivering an excellent guest experience while balancing operating cost and efficiency.

YOU'LL ACCOMPLISH THESE GOALS BY:

Operational Optimization

Develop order sourcing models to determine when to source from different fulfillment nodes using different carriers to maximize bottom line & speed to guest while protecting the guest experience.
Analyze allocations and order flows to recommend potential changes to sourcing logic to achieve expected business results.
Use Predictive modeling to support proactive action to drive benefits to our business.
Utilize software that has the capability to simulate scenarios to optimize use of the omnichannel fulfillment network.

Data Analysis and Insights:

Gather data and use appropriate analytical methods, mathematical models, and tools such as, but not limited to SQL, Python, Power BI, and Tableau to develop flexible, scalable fulfillment network models/what-if scenarios to understand, predict and improve network fulfillment, flows and processes.
Explain and present complex approaches in a concise manner to garner buy in from business partners.

Performance Metrics and Monitoring

Own the development and maintenance of ongoing metrics, models, analyses, and dashboards in connection with the Network Fulfillment team.
Conduct ad-hoc analysis, create reporting and metrics for Network Fulfillment
Demonstrate a high degree of originality and creativity when developing solutions to improve existing business processes within network fulfillment, utilizing methods such as predictive modeling, statistical analysis, regression modeling, and optimization.
Work with internal partners to assess business needs and transform them into meaningful outcomes by selecting optimal analytic technique(s) depending on the nature of the business problem.
Ensure data integrity by leveraging proven methodologies, including data reconciliation, data integration and data audits.
Work as a liaison among stakeholders to elicit, analyze, communicate, and validate requirements for changes to Network Fulfillment programs.
Determine continuous improvement opportunities and support projects to allow the organization to make trade-off decisions quickly with data.
Develop reporting tools, data sets, and visualizations to inform stakeholders on the Omnichannel business health.

THE ESSENTIALS FOR SUCCESS:

Bachelor's or Master's degree in related discipline preferred (e.g. Supply Chain, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering)
Experience in retail and eCommerce industries
Experience with Supply Chain processes
3-5 years of professional experience in analytical functions
Knowledge of OMS/DOM and exposure to retail domains with focus on Order Management and Fulfillment Optimization modules (e.g., IBM Sterling, Manhattan DOM, etc.)
Experience using statistical computer languages (e.g., Python, R) and related frameworks to manipulate data and draw insights from large data sets.
Experience with SQL and related data access and analysis tools to mine data, identify insights, and extract features.
Energetic and self-motivated with a strong sense of curiosity - must be extremely organized and detail oriented with an ability to make proactive recommendations.
Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills to communicate complex ideas to various audiences in both a technical and user-friendly language.
Demonstrated ability to work effectively both in a team environment and independently by handling multiple projects, meeting deadlines, prioritizing appropriately, and responding to issues quickly and creatively with an open and positive attitude.

The pay range for this position is $90,800.00 - $126,000.00 / Year with the opportunity for eligible associates to earn additional compensation pursuant to the Company’s bonus plan. Exact pay will be based on factors including, but not limited to relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, level, shift, geographic location, and business and organizational needs. Full-time positions are eligible for paid time off, health, dental, vision, life and disability benefits. Part-time positions are eligible for dental, vision, life, and disability benefits. For additional information concerning our benefits, visit our Benefits and Career Development page: https://learn.bswift.com/ulta

About

At Ulta Beauty
(NASDAQ: ULTA), the possibilities are beautiful
. Ulta Beauty is the largest North American beauty retailer and the premier beauty destination for cosmetics, fragrance, skin care products, hair care products and salon services. We bring possibilities to life through the power of beauty each and every day in our stores and online with more than 25,000 products from approximately 500 well-established and emerging beauty brands across all categories and price points, including Ulta Beauty’s own private label. Ulta Beauty also offers a full-service salon in every store featuring—hair, skin, brow, and make-up services.

We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest records, conviction records, or other criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of any applicable state and local laws, including the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the New York City Fair Chance Act.

jobs.title: CPGR Growth Leader - AI Engineering, Strategic Accounts
jobs.description:
CPGR Growth Leader, AI Engineering, Strategic Accounts

Fractal is a strategic AI partner to Fortune 500 companies, with a vision to power every human decision in the enterprise. We believe the future belongs to organizations that combine human imagination with intelligent systems, and Fractalites are the ones helping build that future.

We are seeking a senior, client-facing growth leader to own the AI Engineering workstream across a portfolio of strategic accounts. This leader will create C-suite access, originate enterprise transformation opportunities, and shape them into scaled, multi-year programs spanning AI, data, cloud, and engineering modernization.

Please visit Fractal | Intelligence for Imagination for more information about Fractal

Location:
New York, NY or Chicago, IL (Onsite)

Note:
This position is not eligible for Immigration Sponsorship at this time.

Role Overview:

As Growth Leader - AI Engineering, Strategic Accounts, you will sit at the intersection of strategic account growth, technology advisory, and transformation execution. You will build trusted relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, business executives, and their leadership teams; understand their enterprise priorities; and translate those priorities into a differentiated AI engineering and modernization agenda. You will own the opportunity lifecycle from executive dialogue and problem definition through solution shaping, commercial closure, mobilization, and scale. Success means moving beyond isolated pilots: creating funded transformation roadmaps, building durable executive sponsorship, and expanding Fractal's role into repeatable, enterprise-wide programs with measurable business and technology outcomes.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Growth & C-Suite Engagement

Own the AI Engineering growth agenda, qualified pipeline, bookings, revenue, and profitable expansion across assigned strategic accounts.
Develop and sustain trusted-advisor relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, Chief Digital Officers, business presidents, and senior technology leaders across multiple buying centers.
Create executive-level points of view on AI-led transformation and enterprise modernization, connecting technology choices to growth, productivity, resilience, speed, and customer experience.
Map account priorities, stakeholders, budgets, decision processes, and competitive positions; convert this insight into focused account and pursuit plans.
Lead executive briefings, innovation sessions, modernization assessments, and co-creation workshops that generate sponsored, outcome-led transformation opportunities.

Transformation Origination & Enterprise Modernization

Identify and shape strategic initiatives across data-platform and cloud modernization, AI/ML engineering, GenAI and agentic AI, application and software engineering, intelligent operations, and enterprise automation.
Translate a client's current-state technology estate and business ambition into a pragmatic multi-year roadmap, sequenced value cases, target architecture, investment case, and transformation governance model.
Connect modernization of legacy data, applications, integration, and engineering practices with AI readiness, ensuring that foundational work enables near-term business value.
Advise clients on responsible AI, security, privacy, model risk, data governance, interoperability, and operating-model implications required for enterprise adoption.
Bring relevant Fractal capabilities, platforms, accelerators, and industry solutions together into a coherent transformation proposition rather than standalone offerings.

Pursuit Leadership & Program Scale

Lead large, complex pursuits from qualification through proposal, solution architecture, value engineering, commercials, negotiations, and executive closure.
Build compelling business cases with clear baseline metrics, benefits, investment requirements, risks, dependencies, and a credible path from proof of value to production scale.
Orchestrate consulting, AI, data, cloud, product, design, and engineering teams to create one integrated client narrative, solution, and delivery model.
Stay actively engaged through mobilization and critical delivery milestones, protecting the original value thesis, executive confidence, and expansion potential.
Turn successful pilots into reusable platforms and multi-business, multi-region programs; establish references and executive advocacy that accelerate growth across the portfolio.

Ecosystem & Practice Leadership

Build joint propositions and go-to-market motions with Hyperscalers, data and AI platforms, and other strategic technology partners.
Create reusable modernization plays, reference architectures, executive narratives, solution blueprints, estimation models, and pursuit assets that improve win rate and speed.
Share market signals and client needs with capability leaders, helping shape Fractal's AI Engineering offerings, investments, alliances, and talent priorities.
Coach account, solution, and engineering leaders; foster high standards of commercial ownership, technical credibility, collaboration, and client stewardship.

Measures of Success

Growth in qualified pipeline, bookings, revenue, margin, and share of wallet across strategic accounts.
Depth of CIO and technology-leadership sponsorship, and conversion of advisory conversations and pilots into funded, multi-year transformation programs.
Business value realized, client advocacy created repeatability across business units or regions, and disciplined transition from pursuit to delivery.

Required Experience & Skills:

15+ years of experience in technology consulting, digital engineering, data and AI services, or enterprise transformation, including significant responsibility for growth in large strategic accounts.
A demonstrated record of originating, shaping, and winning complex, multi-million-dollar or multi-year transformation programs with enterprise clients.
Established credibility with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, and senior business leaders, with the presence and judgment to challenge constructively and build consensus.
Strong understanding of enterprise modernization across cloud-native architecture, data platforms and Lakehouse patterns, APIs and integration, microservices, DevSecOps, platform engineering, MLOps/LLMOps, observability, and legacy transformation.
Working depth in applied AI, GenAI, agentic systems, RAG, model and data engineering, AI governance, and the requirements for secure, reliable production deployment.
Ability to connect technical architecture and engineering choices to business outcomes, operating-model change, adoption, and a quantified value case.
Strong commercial acumen across opportunity qualification, deal strategy, pricing, contracting, negotiation, risk management, and portfolio economics.
Experience leading multidisciplinary, geographically distributed teams through influence in a matrixed organization.
Excellent executive communication, facilitation, storytelling, and written proposal skills; able to make complex technology choices clear to both business and technical audiences.
Industry experience in CPG, Retail, or another data-intensive enterprise sector is preferred; willingness to travel to client locations as required.

Leadership Competencies:

Strategic account entrepreneurship: sees whitespace, creates momentum, and takes end-to-end ownership for growth.
C-suite influence: earning trust through insight, candor, relevance, and consistent follow-through.
Transformation thinking connecting business ambition, technology modernization, operating-model change, and measurable value.
Technical credibility: goes deep enough to guide architecture and engineering trade-offs without losing the executive narrative.
Commercial discipline: qualifies rigorously, builds investable value cases, and protects sustainable economics.
Enterprise orchestration: aligns diverse client, Fractal, and partner stakeholders around one outcome and plan.
Scale mindset: designs for adoption, reuse, governance, and repeatability from the beginning.
Judgment and integrity: makes responsible decisions, surfaces risks early, and puts long-term client trust first.

Education:

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related field. A master's degree, MBA, or equivalent advanced qualification is preferred.

Pay:

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Fractal, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the starting base salary for this role is $220,000
, with the potential for a higher base depending on experience, skills, and overall fit for the position. This role is also eligible for a performance-based bonus tied to achieving sales goals related to new client acquisition and project growth.

Benefits:

As a full-time employee of the company, or as an hourly employee working more than 30 hours per week, you will be eligible to participate in the health, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability plans in accordance with the plan documents, which may be amended from time to time. You will be eligible for benefits on the first day of employment with the Company. In addition, you are eligible to participate in the Company 401(k) Plan after 30 days of employment, in accordance with the applicable plan terms. The Company provides for 11 paid holidays and 12 weeks of Parental Leave. We also follow a “free time” PTO policy, allowing you the flexibility to take the time needed for either sick time or vacation.

Fractal provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Executive

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

Business Consulting and Services, IT Services and IT Consulting, and Food and Beverage Retail
